name: pre-reflection-sync
description: Notion Worker that bridges Reflection-property edits on the PRE Sessions database back into the PRE coach's SQLite store via the Railway PUT /sessions/<id>/reflection endpoint.

scripts.env:set: echo 'Run: ntn workers env set NOTION_TOKEN <value>; ntn workers env set RAILWAY_BASE_URL <value>; ntn workers env set WORKER_BRIDGE_SECRET <value>'
